post_hoc_disclosure: The rules below were generated after visually reviewing every one of the 3422 frozen 2014-2020 mother-signal charts in chronological order. This is development research, not independent confirmation. No 2021 signal or outcome and no 2022-2024 outcome was used to define the rules.
economic_summary: The mother event is useful only when it represents genuine price discovery through a clear supply corridor, occurs while broad demand is strengthening rather than merely retaining a stale BULL label, is not one of many simultaneous early-bull escapes unsupported by durable breadth, and is accepted on the next observable trading session.

frozen_rules.plain_language: Keep the exact frozen BULL distributed-accumulation escape mother signal without changing any of its thresholds or cooldown.
frozen_rules.implementation: event identity must be present in candidates_frozen.parquet from ASHARE-BULL-DISTRIBUTED-ACCUMULATION-12M-CHART-DISCOVERY-V2

frozen_rules.plain_language: The breakout must either exceed the highest pre-existing high in the prior 126 completed market sessions or leave at least the fixed 15 percent target distance before that old high; reject breakouts that run directly into old overhead supply.
frozen_rules.implementation: after an exact, valid, corporate-action-clean 126-session pre-signal coordinate history, require signal_coord_close > prior126_coord_high OR prior126_coord_high >= 1.15 * signal_coord_close

frozen_rules.plain_language: At the signal close, both the return pace and participation of the most recent 20 sessions must be at least as strong as the prior 60-session market path.
frozen_rules.implementation: require (1 + market_median_ret20)^3 >= (1 + market_median_ret60) AND market_positive_ret20_share >= market_positive_ret60_share; all inputs are completed signal-date cross-sectional observations

frozen_rules.plain_language: If fewer than 80 percent of stocks have positive 60-session returns, reject days with more than 25 simultaneous mother signals; then require the first legal completed stock session after the signal, within three market sessions, to close at or above the signal close before buying on a later legal open.
frozen_rules.implementation: require market_positive_ret60_share >= 0.80 OR same_date_mother_count <= 25; find the first post-signal valid tradable session within cal_idx+3 in the unchanged coordinate lineage and require coord_close >= signal_coord_close; entry begins strictly after that confirmation close

translation.entry: first legal non-upper-limit open in the three market sessions strictly after the acceptance-confirmation session
translation.time_stop: after thirty held market sessions, then the first legal sellable open
